To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
cryogenic co-grind SDs of poorly soluble drugs with carrier polymers can be prepared and the solid-state stability and drug release behavior are influenced by the carrier polymer used.
the carrier polymer influences both the degree of drug amorphization and stabilization of the amorphous state against recrystallization.

cryogenic co-grinded solid dispersions of piroxican (PRX) with polyvinylpyrolidone (PV) showed an enhanced dissolution of the drug while those with catalytic pretreated cellulose showed a clear sustained release.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new class of carrier polymers, namely CPSC.
the development of novel SDs for improving the solubility and dissolution of poorly water-solvable APIs.

the use of CPSC, a renewable and abundant resource, for the preparation of cryogenic co-ground amorphous SD of PRX, which could potentially be used as an alternative to PVP for preparing and stabilising amorphous SD formulations of poorly water-solvable drugs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
cryogenic co-grinded amorphous SD prepared from PVP exhibited a rapid drug release, whereas the corresponding SD prepared from CPSC provided a controlled release.
cryogenic co-grinded SDs of PRX prepared from PVP exhibited an enhanced immediate-release behavior, while SDs from CPSC exhibited an enhanced sustained-release behavior.
the cryogenic co-grind SDs with CPSC as carrier polymer is a potential approach for improving the solubility and sustained release of PRX.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
cryogenic co-grind SDs prepared from softwood CPSC and PVP are promising for preparing SDs of poorly soluble drugs with a controlled dissolution rate.
CPSC and PVP are both promising excipients for preparing and stabilising SDs of PRX.
cryogenic co-grindings of poorly water-soruble drugs with CPSC are a promising approach for preparing amorphously dispersed solid formulations.
The main takeaway from our work is that
CPSC is a promising carrier polymer for stabilizing SDs of poorly soluble APIs.
the choice of carrier polymer is crucial in order to achieve an optimized formulation of poorly water-solvable APIs.
CPSC is a promising carrier polymer for the preparation of amorphous SD formulations.
